label: Emergency & Wildfire Squawks → TAK
info:
Aircraft squawking 7500 (hijack), 7600 (lost comms), 7700 (emergency) or 1255 (firefighting) over Tennessee (plus a small buffer).

Data: adsb.fi open data API (https://github.com/adsbfi/opendata). Updates every 17 seconds.

Needs: [node-red-contrib-tak](https://flows.nodered.org/node/node-red-contrib-tak) (Manage palette > Install).

Setup:
1. Double-click TAK Server :8089, set your TAK Server address, then edit its TLS config and upload your client certificate and key.
2. Click Deploy.

Full instructions: https://github.com/SECT0101/NodeRED-TAK/tree/main/flows/emergency-squawks
